title: End Minus Start
kicker: Under the Pond · Floor One, Part 1
blurb: Floor one. A lift that takes a change, and a track of three spans. A change is end minus start, and slope is the same idea done twice: change in height over change in posts. Uphill, flat and downhill. Somebody else is down here, moving the floor.
note: Captions stay on. It opens on the cliffhanger at span three, then goes back four minutes. Pause after Marcus says "Plus six!" and ask what is about to go wrong. When the llama spits, ask whether a slope of zero is broken. When the Flipper steals the minus, ask which way the cart should go. Level means the lift only: on the track the graph reads posts and height.
